title: ARCS Trajectory — composable span-to-render schema
description: One serialization for any bounded span of work (a day, a session, a git range, an arc). Drives the Daily Trajectory / Flow Ledger render. Atlas-compatible: `span.frame` is the sovereign zero (WORLD.md Field Geometry, Tao V); every metric is honest-null until instrumented; `fidelity` binds render resolution to earned certainty (WORLD.md Render Scale).

kind.description: What unit this span serializes. Same schema, different granularity — this is the composability claim.

frame.description: The sovereign zero this span is projected from (IANA tz for a day; repo@branch for a git-range). No frame is canonical; the frame is declared, per Tao V.

provenance.description: Every source that fed this span, each with a confidence. An empty array is itself an honest signal.

fidelity.description: Render resolution the data has EARNED. GRAIN = sparse/unverified; SHARP = fully sourced. The render must never exceed this.

metrics.description: The flow ledger. Every field is nullable ON PURPOSE — null means 'not instrumented', never 0. Fabricating a number here is the one forbidden move.

turns.description: Conversation turns in the span. Requires session instrumentation; null until then.

commits.description: Sealed commits. Available from git today.

flow_ratio.description: commits / turns (or output / turn). The peak-flow signal. Null until turns are logged.

nci.description: Quality gate. Null when the span's commits are [NCI:SKIP].

zones.description: Ordered phase-zones the span descends through (WORLD.md four-zone model).

recorded.description: True only if a transcript/recording actually exists. The Ahmed call is recorded:false — scheduled, not transcribed.

tags.description: Insight/receipt tags attached live. See the tagging protocol.

receipts.description: DEWY receipts and witness stubs linked to this span. The compounding ledger.

verbatim.description: For a witness stub: the sound the tree made, not a summary of it.
